control.description-key: PBS Hub host app H-4 Report saya: the host reports for one month with status chips (Belum dikirim, Perlu revisi, Menunggu review, Selesai, Otomatis disetujui).

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: pageSize (20), absenLeadMin, reportDeadlineDays, requireAbsen.

property.name: Period
property.description-key: Month shown, yyyy-mm. Empty means the current month. The month picker sends PERIOD_CHANGED; canvas reloads the rows and sets this.

property.name: DefaultFilter
property.description-key: All, Unsent, Revision, Waiting, Done or Auto.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ID, Title, ScheduleID, LiveDate, BrandID, Platform, Account, Penjualan, ApprovalStatus, ApprovalComment, Created, Modified.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this host and month: Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, BrandID, Platform, Account, Status. Used for Belum dikirim.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ClockInDate.

property.name: AbsenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host Absence - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ScheduleID.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when the server has more reports for the month than were sent: shows Muat lebih banyak (LOAD_MORE).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. The list has no locking action; only shown as a banner.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_REPORT, NEW_REPORT, PERIOD_CHANGED, FILTER_CHANGED, LOAD_MORE.
